episodes.synopsis: Kyōma Mabuchi, a Collector, runs into some trouble on a job and ends up bringing back an android girl named Mira.
episodes.title: Collector

episodes.synopsis: Kyōma and his new partner, Mira, are after the art thief Loser's illegal coils, but what is Loser really after?
episodes.title: Loser

episodes.synopsis: Mira finally settles into life at the gasoline stand, but will New Tesla find out her secret after an incident with some neighborhood kids?
episodes.title: Chase the Numbers

episodes.synopsis: Kyōma and Mira end up at a village with a dark past after Albert asks them to investigate the mysterious death of novelist Shijuro Sakaki.
episodes.title: The Mystery Hidden in Lake Yasogami

episodes.synopsis: Mira is trapped in the past as Kyōma and the others fight against the ghosts in the fog attacking the hotel.
episodes.title: The Possibilities of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Prince Salva-Enna-Tibesti, CEO of Islero and COO of Central 60, visits Central 47 with his younger brother, Lwai, who loves Japan.
episodes.title: The Wind of Africa

episodes.synopsis: Kyōma recalls his past as he gets ready to join the other Collectors on Easter Island.
episodes.title: The Voice Calling from the Past

episodes.synopsis: Kyōma and the other Collectors are on Easter Island in a race to collect the special coil that Prince Salva is after.
episodes.title: The Island That Fell into Nothingness

episodes.synopsis: Kyōma and Salva enter their memories as they and Loser remember their pasts and put more pieces of the puzzle together.
episodes.title: The Key to Adrastea

episodes.synopsis: Kyōma starts to connect the dots as he fights with an old comrade controlled by K.K., and the truth is revealed about Lwai.
episodes.title: Resurrected Nightmare

episodes.synopsis: Loser shows the others his memories, and Kyōma starts to remember more of his past as they search for the lost coil, Genesis.
episodes.title: The Lost Genesis

episodes.synopsis: Mira helps Kyōma put the pieces of his memories back together as they all fight to bring down Seameyer together.
episodes.title: The Future Reached
